---
title: "Human Protein Atlas brain summary"
author: "Emily Gunn"
---

Here is a sum of the number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain region of humans pigs and mice

```{r}
human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
pig <- sum(190, 157, 31, 45)
mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)

print(paste("humans have", human, "genes with regionally elevated expression, pigs have", pig, "and mice have", mouse ))
```
Humans have more genes with regionally elevated expression.
